One word, one meaning: the editor is the one who gives (pays for) the games — the rulebook's term. Flavius is the empire's great editor; win in a city and its own editor takes the box. A house's financial backer is money behind a ludus, not the games' host.

New in v0.40: a grouped left rail for Manager mode and the Creator Studio in full screen (Ludus · Arena · World · Lanista; Overview · Fighters · Gear · Arena · Tools).

New in v0.32: blood, severed limbs and the clean-up crew; sculpting on the gear benches with the art in the fighter's hand; "the editor" named properly everywhere; flags became banners; the city square roomier, textured and speed-controlled with the gate flow into Match Week; Safari audio unlocked; Settings reorganized (Themes tab, Voices & bubbles); attendance scales with the card.

New in v0.23: Board tokens — Standees, sculpted Figures or the original Cylinders (Settings), true-to-scale standees, and a 🗿 Token creator in the Creator Studio for every class, beast and creation · every event you play moves the empire's calendar one week · New event opens on Roma · Classic Democritus, with the options spanning the bottom, and the top bar follows your pick · Imperium joins the main bar; the Fates table lives inside Standings · named beasts read “Archimedes (Human)” · Manager mode: Roster & Recruiting, the ledger and the Fallen under the training yard, the league rules on the Lanista page, a full 📈 Exchange tab, a Match Week results sheet after “Simulate every remaining bout”, “Walk the sand” for this week's arena, and an Acta Diurna with top-ten tables and an Overheard column of real crowd chatter and imperial satire.

New in v0.20: the empire keeps a calendar — a Roman date on every event, and a 12-week season schedule (one arena a week, classics by far the commonest, rare specials with fatter purses, Cassian's Grand Games in week XII) that Manager mode locks into and New event opens on (play off-schedule if you like); the top bar reads where, when, and the round in one breath; every city names its own beasts (Capua's bears are Tifata and Sannio, its champion Spartacus…) — with per-beast ledgers in the Menagerie, custom beasts' ledgers, and a 🐾 beast tab in the name generator; manager mode: bribe the levy (or let them march), a bookmaker's cut of every wager laid on your rostered fighters, 🔭 arena scouting ahead of match night (+1 AP, +1 coin at the gates), Promote and Schooling moved to Your ludus, and a Lanista tab that fits on one screen; Imperium: the empire's 15 weightiest events up top, then a city card with the stands, local news and mood, the pens, the top-5 local heroes, who lives there and what they are doing right now (attendees only during a live event); spectators wear two-part togas (tunic in their home city's wool, mantle in their fighter's colors); a CF ledger on the player board (hover CF ⓘ); Flavius keeps clear of the sand with the stands off; big windows hold their size across tabs; and Infamis & Hall is now the Annals.

New in v0.19: 🐾 Menagerie — Beasts & cards grown into a full window with a Bestiary: lore, stats and all-time ledgers (slain, gladiators eaten, tamed) for every beast; Imperium reworked — fans now travel real roads and sea lanes (⛵ dashed) instead of crow-flight, the radar sweep is gone, weather reads bolder, a ⚔️ war-map layer shows who presses whom (severity-3 wars CLOSE that arena and the levy may conscript soldiers — survive the war for a hero's return, +rating, +fame, fans across the empire), 🌋 Vesuvius stirs near Pompeii, and the focused city gets its own framed tile; Ludus gladiators wear star ratings everywhere; Manager mode gains a 🏜 Sandbox (lethality, blood-money prices, injuries, training gains, rookie influx — all sliders), a season-ending festival finale in Roma (leader picks the festival, top four stables draft champions, Cassian presides), 🏺 Archives (every Acta of the season re-readable, leather-bound season recaps, also shelved in the Annals), 📯 promotion (feast a city, sponsor games, hire criers — fans land on the Imperium map), 🤝 bout-fixing (guaranteed win, real risk: caught twice in a career and Flavius seizes the ludus; even unseen, bought palms weigh on the barracks), an ⚕ Infirmary (the wound picks its cure — rest, Medicus, or the surgeon's knife; festering wounds kill, send fighters fleeing, or scar them; bathhouse days and the priests of Asclepius for the rich; badly-hurt arena survivors are now carried to the Ludus infirmary automatically and must be treated within four events), tab icons throughout, ★ Favorites (the Board, renamed and explained), a sharper Your scouts column (▲ value / ▼ trap against the bookmaker), hoverable disabled buttons that say what they need, an on-screen 📍 location chip for every event, a hoverable coin ledger on the player board, and smarter CPU tunnels (escape AND travel) and pillar-toppling (weaponless looters bring the pillar down).

New in v0.18: Manager mode now plays by the printed Fate table — every fighter in every league bout, win or lose: under 17 CF condemned, 17-19 the Thumb of Flavius, 20-49 the Ludus Flavius, 50+ the rudis — with blood money (pay the editor to buy back a condemned fighter) and your own thumbs, blood money and rudis choices waiting on Match Week; results show finishing order and each fighter's Fate by name; the Thumb of Flavius is now a ritual — you roll the d6 yourself (4-6 spared) and, if it goes down, the d12, with Flavius reacting at every roll; a missio means what the rulebook says — a five-event campaign — everywhere; The Stands became 🌍 Imperium: a map with fans streaming in (colored by whom they cheer), a weather "doppler", and world events (politics, war, economy, famine, earthquakes, plague, trade) that move attendance and moods, plus who of note is in attendance; spectators wear robes (color them in the creator), can be bought tickets (seated now, or guaranteed next time) — and you can ticket your fighters' families for loyalty; off-duty league fighters sometimes watch from the stands; rare famous visitors from Roman history (toggle in Settings); a 🏋 Practice tab for exhibitions against rival stables (nobody dies — the doctors pull them; the stands fill with gladiators who only watch and talk); the Acta Diurna previews next week (forecast, world news, the card, purses, bad blood); cards always show beside every manager list; gladiatrices (♀, mostly Amazonia) join the league; the Ludus's active roster (now 8) stands apart from the rolls; and American spelling throughout ("doctore" is now the Latin doctor).

New in v0.17: spectators default to 🎲 Random — the empire decides: the city's appetite, hometown regulars, every fan, kin and patron following today's fighters, the billing and the omen fill the stands (the log says why), and manager live-watches use it too; the header wears icons, the ⚙️ settings cog sits alone at the far right, and Standings pulses in the leader's color (flashing when the lead changes); visual sliders (board brightness, text size, highlights) now stay where you leave them, even across arena tints; manager results now say eliminated · spared (missio — back to the ludus) vs ✝ killed (gone for good); the recruiting Board opens cards in its own side panel (and a Scout-button lockup is fixed); and your own fighters get a full card with retention actions — meals, a private word, bonuses, raises, main-event promises, a personal doctor — all feeding a loyalty meter that rivals must beat to poach them.

New in v0.16: five festivals to choose from, each with its own between-events gift (Ludi Apollinare, Saturnalia, Asclepieia, Vulcanalia, Fors Fortuna); The Stands is now a full window — the spectator world's hub, with empire-wide fandom counts, home cities (regulars pack their own city's stands first), family ties and a pool grown to ~160 regulars; manager mode gains a career chronicle on every fighter (wins, signings, poaches, class changes, deaths — with team, arena and date), a perk tree for the lanista (points earned each week, spent the next, on the same traits recruits grade), training regimes (light/standard/brutal — cheaper is safer, brutal bruises) plus a per-fighter personal doctor, gems and the overhyped hidden in the recruit pool (scout twice or run a trial bout on your own sand to find out), recruit cards for your own signed fighters (with ★ pinning everywhere), win-rate now sways recruit interest, bout injuries, freedom purchases and thematic deaths at season's end, a tiny weekly chance anyone simply dies (bookies, fevers, roof tiles), and real age variance — the old are not automatically good, and the good do not always last.

New in v0.15: league fighters now carry ages (the young arrive as slaves and soldiers, the graying re-badge as Veteranus, and past 35 they start hanging up the sword), generated faces, a debut date, and mid-career class changes the criers report; "granted missio" is now explained where it happens (the editor's mercy — spared, keeping the bout's CF); a weekly training yard budget drills your whole stable, with a report in the Acta Diurna and the occasional training injury (Medicus clears it); your ludus keeps a private ledger of everything that touched it; festival gladiators now choose their boon (laurels, purse, elixir, armor fitting, or Flavius' notice); spectators can be created as kin of a gladiator — family colors in the stands, grief when they fall; the Ludus grid sinks the fallen and retired to the last tiles with a ⇄ tile-swap system; and the Hints toggle now lives on the arena itself.

New in v0.14: seeded dice — set a Dice seed in Options and the whole event replays identically (the seed is stamped on the results banner, so any legendary match can be re-fought roll for roll); every event now opens with the pompa — a proper procession, roll call and (with hints on) a primer on the mode; CPU speed always starts on Slow; ending a manager week now prints the Acta Diurna — a week-end gazette with a generated lead story, the league's top fives and the obituaries; the League table lists each stable's top 3 rivals with a separate "toward you" gauge; Manager mode stretches out on big screens; and the spectator creator's face preview updates properly with a 🎲 randomizer to match.

New in v0.13: retirement is real now — one confirm and the record is deleted from the game forever, though about one in four dodges Flavius's ledger and turns up in the cheap seats as a spectator, story intact; a spectator gets exactly ONE offer of the sword and some refuse it (ask the sausage guy — he also declines); buy a spectator's cheers (5 coin from your lanista) for any gladiator in play or on your roster; and a certain pair of anonymous crowd voices now narrate disasters in the stands log.

New in v0.12: The Stands drawer above the arena (T / B keys) — beast tracker and cards in play, the arena's own chronicle (last spectator speared and by whom, concessions, brawls, commonest omen), and a full spectator roster with an inspector: personal lore, bans, standing a round, and signing a regular to your ludus as a raw recruit; troublemakers slip in (two at most); a Spectator creator in the Studio; per-location crowd temperaments layered on your sliders; you roll the Thumb of Flavius d6 yourself in the results window; theme colors for stands, pillars, pots, spikes, chest and rubble (all captured in saved profiles); distinct preset previews; a Recruiting board (★) in Manager mode; live-watched bouts sharpen scouting; the chariot card, horse and wheel tokens and the Lyre of Orpheus shown as real equipment.

New in v0.11: sharper CPUs (shield discipline, danger-aware pathing, no more losing track of a walled-in beast); the strategy guide rebuilt on 300 fresh simulations, with sections on the newer rules and manager recruiting; a deeper recruiting portal (gifts, main-event pledges, grade tooltips that say how to raise them); fight your entered fighter yourself on match night; morale and a living Rivalry system in the League tab; the code under the hood now reads like a guided tour.

New in v0.10: section cheers scale with attendance (a big house cheers louder, not richer) and attendance is recorded everywhere; per-event high scores; spectator contribution shown in results; crowd personality sliders; per-location arena palettes; lock/unlock on saved creations with an unlock log; gladiatrix option in the creator; force-retire in the Ludus; no coin-camping in the Gauntlet (12 stingy spectators at most, and the editor's lash); abandoning a live event now has mortal consequences.

New in v0.9: the printed player-board avatar with your equipped armor tokens worn on the body; armor art cut out with transparent backgrounds; the printed square tunnel tokens on the board; chariot cards, horse and wheel tokens and the Naumachia water tokens as printed, with hover popups.

New in v0.8: shields absorb by choice; freedom (the rudis) for 50+ CF winners, memorialized among the Liberti; a persistent crowd of regulars with memories, faces and allegiance colors; match-day omens swaying attendance, purses and hometown fighters; Flavius himself reacting above the A-1 corner; a deeper Creator Studio (named skin tones, ability values, beast templates); career leaderboard and one-click lanistae at the bookmaker's table.

New in v0.6–0.7: spectator tastes, tempers and moods with emotes (up to 48 in the stands, one section per class color); the bookmaker's wagers, banked in your active lanista's treasury; the Creator Studio (custom characters, beasts and events, name generator); Manager mode with bankruptcy, weekly repairs and generated rivals; the roguelike Ludus (saved gladiators update automatically after every event they fight in — the fallen are struck for good).
